summary: Tested the Preview Crew Member Invite feature and the email block on the Model Vessel (backend and frontend, 390x844, test_session_pro_1). Backend: 8 of 8 pytest pass. GET /crew-preview returns roles with read_at null and agreement, walkthrough and joincrew_offer empty. It returns 404 for a boat you don't own and 401 without a session. On the Model Vessel, an email invite returns email_blocked true and the log shows 'Email not sent (Model Vessel training)'. On main it returns email_blocked false. Frontend: the preview button sits under the Quick Invite hint. Before any invite it shows the warning toast. After Copy WhatsApp message or Send email invite, the preview dialog opens with a banner naming TEST_Tom and a Join button. Join opens the agreement with its own preview banner, Standard terms, Your role briefing and Boat Walk Through (0 of 7). Ticking a briefing and walking all 7 stops works locally. Accept and Later both show the 'Nothing was saved' toast. No POST/PUT/DELETE was sent while previewing. Reopening resets to 0 of 7 and unread. The Model Vessel email toast text is correct. One real bug: the preview ignores the stops the skipper picked for this crew member.

ui_bugs.issue: If the skipper sets 'Walkthrough stops for this crew member' (e.g. 'Own stops, 4 of 7'), the invite is saved with walk_skip and the real crew member sees 4 stops. The preview still shows 'BOAT WALK THROUGH (0 OF 7 TICKED)' because it uses the boat's default walk_skip. So the preview is not 'exactly what Tom sees'.

issues: The dialog's close X sits on the amber crew-invite-preview-banner and overlaps the end of the banner's first line ('...to join'). Add right padding (e.g. pr-10) to the banner, as is also needed for crew-agreement-preview-banner.

When expanded, the training window covers the bottom of tall dialogs (agreement Accept/Later, invite buttons). Playwright clicks were intercepted by training-step-text until training-shrink-btn was pressed. This was here before this change, but it hurts this flow.

action_items: Pass the invite's walk_skip into the preview: store walkSkip in lastInvite and use boat={...boat, walk_skip: lastInvite.walk_skip ?? boat.walk_skip} for CrewAgreementDialog, or have /crew-preview accept walk_skip. Then the stop count matches what the crew member gets.
Add right padding to the preview banners so the dialog's close X does not overlap the text.
critical_code_review_comments: InviteCrewDialog sets lastInvite before the toast and clears the draft. lastInvite keeps roles and trip_name but not walk_skip (see the bug above).

The model_vessel_no_email middleware only matches '/boats/model_vessel/' in the path or ?boat_id=model_vessel. Any Model Vessel email route that sends boat_id in a JSON body would still send email. Check routes such as /crew/* that take owner_id/boat_id in the body.
The Model Vessel toast says 'Invite saved for <email>'. That is fine, but the WhatsApp toast uses the name, so consider the crew name for consistency.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (1 functional mismatch with own walk stops)

seed_data_creation: None kept. TEST_Tom invites (test_tom_prev187@example.com, test_preview_*@example.com) on model_vessel and main were created and deleted. 0 remain.
